title_sq: Tek Shkolla e Kuqe, Shitet Dyqan, Buze Rruge!!

title_en: Near the Red School, Shop for Sale, Side of the Road!!
description_en: In front of the Red School, Business premises for sale, for different types of business!!! The property is located on the 0th floor of a new building, with a net area of ​​60 m2. The environment is organized in a duplex and has 3 rooms and 1 toilet. Considering the positioning of the property, which is on the edge of the main road, it is suitable for different types of business such as: shops, offices, clinics, etc. The area in which the environment is located is one of the most sought after in Tirana. The property has full mortgage documentation.
